scope: One actual full France scene pocket core-wing-1--5, with production furnishings and all non-target moving closures parked closed. Original casing positive retained; actual target leaves swept against all static world rendered triangles. No collision exclusions or contact waivers. Other doors, actor routes and visual coverage remain separate.

affineSweep.sourceFormula: poseDoor slide: fixed transforms, pivot lateral = side * (width/4 + overlap/2 + fraction * authoredTravel)

stages.staticScope: Every lot mesh except the two target moving leaf subtrees; includes own fixed supports, other closed doors/curtains, full roof, actual room walls, floor, furniture and ornamental casing

sourcePrimitiveAudit.method: Every packed triangle belongs to exactly one source primitive range; each range position SHA equals the original transformed source buffer. Other meshes retain their original separate identity. Containment is computed per original primitive and combined by union, never aggregated over overlapping solids.
